summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC filed a 6-K announcing CEO Global Lottery Renato Ascoli will step down effective June 30, 2026, replaced by Marco Tasso as EVP & COO Global Lottery effective July 1, 2026. Tasso previously served as COO International & Italy. The change is part of Brightstar's optimization as a pure-play lottery business. No price, premium, or deal structure terms are applicable. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The filing reports a routine leadership succession, not a contest or forced departure. Watch for any future strategic shifts under Tasso's operational leadership.
